Q020.reason: The Marshall Plan was the 1948 US program of economic aid to rebuild postwar Europe.

Q021.reason: NSC 68 (1950) called for a large military buildup, a shift from economic containment to military containment.

Q022.reason: The Monroe Doctrine (1823) warned European powers to stay out of the Western Hemisphere, including Latin America.

Q023.reason: The Truman Doctrine committed the US to resisting communism worldwide, so it framed local revolts through a global geopolitical lens.

Q024.reason: A multipolar system has three or more major powers, while bipolar has two and unipolar has one.
